purpose: Post-result diagnosis of the already-revealed C7a failures. Replay the exact C7a samples and frozen provider to locate the hydraulic response regions that produce the failed max, p99, strong-gradient and near-saturation checks before any new representation hypothesis is designed.

required_per_class_outputs.owner_seam_proximity_diagnostic: Report proximity to relsat=0.999999 but do not infer causation from proximity alone.

interpretation_rules.R3_geometry: Supported only when paired geometries differ materially and the high-error rows are concentrated in strong gradients without owner-seam evidence dominating.
interpretation_rules.R4_material_transition: Supported when both geometries show the same localized response pattern away from the known constitutive seam.
interpretation_rules.R5_owner_overlap: Mandatory caution when high-error rows are near the relsat=0.999999 conductivity jump or when h=0/near-saturation behavior dominates. Numerical repair must not silently reinterpret qualified constitutive semantics.
interpretation_rules.R6_family_rejection: Already established for the full-catalog n49 claim. C7D may localize subpatterns but cannot reverse C7a.
